name: const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> Pin < Ptr >
rule: Unless Ptr::Target implements Unpin, the caller must ensure that the storage of the data pointed to by pointer is not invalidated until the data is dropped.
api: impl < Ptr : Deref > core::pin::Pin < Ptr > { const unsafe fn new_unchecked (pointer : Ptr) -> core::pin::Pin < Ptr > }
